[[Geno Darkheart]] is a [[Centaur]] [[boss]] that sometimes appears in the [[Deldrimor Bowl]].

== Locations ==
* [[Northern Shiverpeaks]]
** {{NPC location|Deldrimor Bowl}}

== Missions ==
* Northern Shiverpeaks
** {{NPC location|Borlis Pass}}

== Skills ==
* None

== Items dropped ==
* [[Shiverpeak Mane]]
* [[Shiverpeak Necromancer Tunic]]
* [[Snowy Centaur Hide]]

== Notes ==
* He can also appear in Anvil Rock and during the Borlis Pass mission, but he will not always appear there.
* He shares his spawning point in the [[Borlis Pass]] mission with [[Yino Burlyhaunch]], [[Rubi Spottedmane]], [[Jolo Lighthaunch]], [[Ullo Specterhaunch]], and [[Moro Stormcalf]].
